## 0be8ff9b4144

### Reproduced defect: advertised exact overrides are unreachable
For seed 0, sample index 0, with only `grid_h=5`, the generator raises
`draw_int('grid_h'): override 5 outside [7, 12]`, although its AXES contract
advertises `5..16`. Likewise the advertised endpoints `grid_h=16`, `grid_w=6`,
`grid_w=18`, `n_top=1`, `n_top=6`, `n_left=1`, and `n_left=6` all reject.
This is not a coupled-axes edge case: each test sets just one axis.
`generate(17, 0, unknown_probe=99)` is also accepted and identical to the default;
`texture='NOT_AN_ALLOWED_TEXTURE'` is accepted.

Evidence: `checks/audit-0be8ff9b4144.json` contains exact arguments, errors, and
source hash. The correct implementation should either honor the documented range
independently of the sampling band or narrow its contract; invalid/unknown
controls should reject explicitly. No fix is proposed in this findings-only audit.

### Rejected hypothesis and clean checks
An initial hypothesis predicted silent marker-count clipping on a tiny board.
It did **not** reproduce: dimension validation raised first. The traceback is
retained in `checks/audit-0be8ff9b4144-iteration1.log`; this report does not turn
an unexecuted clipping branch into a confirmed finding.

The 30 tested ordinary draws and all five canonical pairs match the independent
header-intersection mirror under Racket (35 checks, zero parity mismatches).
No reference-label defect was found in those cases. Ordinary task interpretation
(active 3 rows intersect active 2 columns, overwrite with 5) remains consistent.

resolution_reason: v5.0.0 samples grid_h 5..16/grid_w 6..18 and marker counts 1..6 across every band; compatible exact controls are observed and impossible combinations reject explicitly. Unknown controls/invalid textures reject. Retained 70-test and 84240-override reported evidence plus owner source inspection address this specific finding; no automatic closure of other audits.
